findings.reason: it would add an owner/consumption clause (as the seven other cite-or-justify rulings already do) naming the exterior point evaluator's home and its single consumer.
findings.text: `ForwardFluxOperator.external` is the current owner of exterior-flux evaluation and is deleted at §6, yet §2 requires an exterior-field point evaluator (its plan-comment ruling: "the exterior field enters the read as a differentiable point evaluator") and §4 has `gs.apply` compute ψ_ext as the mesh map's exterior term; neither §2's nor §4's text names which module owns the exterior point evaluator or states that the other consumes it, so the read and the map can each carry their own exterior-field path after the owner is deleted

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — each of the four proposed entry points hides substantial behaviour behind one call site: `topology.read` subsumes seventeen null-finding implementations, `current.book` the exact-clip booking, `gs.apply` the map and its three derivatives, and `solve.fixed_point` absorbs the single-site GMRES kernel, the backtracking search and the reduced-Newton step helpers behind one `lax.scan` call.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the exterior-field evaluator the read needs has no named owner while its current owner retires, so §2 and §4 can each build one.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2–§5 each name in their own text the implementation they replace (`Topology.read`+`read_with_connectivity`, `clipped_support_current_moments`+the support partition, the `ForwardFluxOperator` map, `newton_krylov`+`picard`+`operator_request_body`) and §6 names the public symbols it retires (`SolveRoute`, `SupportClipMode`, the route plumbing fields) with before/after field counts, so no section adds surface unaccounted for.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched both named codebases exhaustively and cites the mechanism each new module replaces; every cited symbol (`Topology.read`/`read_with_connectivity` topology.py:1376/1396, `ForwardFluxOperator.read`/`read_with_current_moments` forward_operator.py:3166/3191, `polygon_monomial_moments`/`polygon_density_moments` polygon_moments.py:141/187, `build_contour_tree` contour_tree.py:384, `scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_guard.py`) exists where named.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every proposed module replaces rather than wraps: §4 states `gs.apply` replaces the map `ForwardFluxOperator` performs "rather than wrapping it", and §2/§3/§5 each name the function they replace instead of layering over it.
